strings: m_c has never really had an interest in forming close relationships with {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} clanmates. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} may have schizoid personality disorder.
m_c rarely expresses strong emotions, often confusing {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} clanmates, but it's never bothered m_c.
m_c has always enjoyed doing things alone rather than with others, no matter how often r_c tries to invite {PRONOUN/m_c/object} to join {PRONOUN/r_c/object}.
Despite the concern of m_c's denmates, r_c says that m_c's lack of interests in friendships is not a concern: m_c just has schizoid personality disorder.
